title: Step 3b - Training Logistic Regression Model: Fit Method for Classification

cues.en: -: Perfect. And now final step, you know what you have to do, right?
cues.zh: 很好，最後一步，你知道該怎麼做吧？

cues.en: We have to take first our classifier and then, well now what we want to do is to train our classifier on the training set because remember that this line
cues.zh: 先使用 classifier，在訓練集上訓練。記得這一行

cues.en: of code only builds the logistic regression model but doesn't train it yet.
cues.zh: 只建立模型，尚未訓練。

cues.en: And this next line of code is indeed the final step where we train our classifier on the training set.
cues.zh: 下一行就是最後的訓練步驟。

cues.en: And remember, to do this, we have to call the fit method, which takes as input two entities, you know, two sets of data.
cues.zh: 呼叫 fit，輸入兩組資料。

cues.en: The first one is the matrix of features of the training set and the second one is the dependent viable vector of the training set, where of course, all the purchase decisions of the dependent viable vector
cues.zh: 第一組是訓練集特徵矩陣，第二組是訓練集應變數向量，其中所有購買決策

cues.en: correspond to the same customers of the matrix of features.
cues.zh: 都對應特徵矩陣中相同的顧客。

cues.en: All right? So what we had to input here was simply x_train for the matrix of features of the training set and then y_train for the dependent viable vector
cues.zh: 所以這裡傳入 X_train，代表訓練集特徵矩陣，再傳入 y_train，代表相同訓練集的

cues.en: of the same training set.
cues.zh: 應變數向量。

cues.en: And there you go, my friends, congratulations if you obtain this.
cues.zh: 如果寫出這樣的結果，恭喜。

cues.en: And also congratulations if you tried because indeed that's how you build the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 只要嘗試過也值得恭喜，這就是建立邏輯斯迴歸的方法。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: That's one extra machinery model in your toolkit and you're gonna have many more.
cues.zh: 工具箱又多了一個機器學習模型，之後還有更多。

cues.en: And don't worry, I will train you on how to select the best one for any data set.
cues.zh: 別擔心，我會教你為任何資料集選最佳模型。

cues.en: Okay, great. So let's run this cell.
cues.zh: 現在執行儲存格。

cues.en: This will, indeed, build and train the logistic regression model on your training set composed of x_train and y_train.
cues.zh: 這會在由 X_train 與 y_train 組成的訓練集上建立並訓練模型。

cues.en: And here by the way, you see all the parameters of the logistic regression model, which you can tune.
cues.zh: 這裡也列出可調整的所有參數。

cues.en: The most famous one is C, which is the inverse of the regularization strength meaning that the smaller is C, the stronger will be the regularization, and therefore,
cues.zh: 最有名的是 C，為正規化強度的倒數。C 越小，正規化越強，

cues.en: the more it will protect you from overfilling.
cues.zh: 越能防止過度擬合。

cues.en: Right? But here, we'll just keep the default value of one.
cues.zh: 這裡保留預設 1。

cues.en: And there you go. We are ready to move on to the next step predicting a new result, and to now new exercise for you because we already did it with regression.
cues.zh: 現在可以進入預測新結果。這不是新練習，因為迴歸時已做過。

cues.en: I taught you before how to, you know, take your regressor and then call the predict method to predict the result of a single observation. And so here the exercise
cues.zh: 先前教過使用 regressor 呼叫 predict，預測單一觀測。所以這裡要練習

cues.en: that I would like you to do is to predict the purchased decision of a single result, you know, the purchase decision of a single customer.
cues.zh: 預測單一顧客的購買決策。

cues.en: And I will tell you which one I would like you to predict the purchased decision of the first customer in the test set, who you will see is 30 years old
cues.zh: 我指定測試集第一位顧客，你會看到他 30 歲，

cues.en: and earns an estimated salary of $87,000.
cues.zh: 估計薪資為 87,000 美元。

cues.en: So I would like you to take these two inputs, you know, these two features with these values: 30 years old and $87,000 at the estimated salary.
cues.zh: 取這兩個特徵值：30 歲與估計薪資 87,000 美元。

cues.en: And I would like you to predict whether this customer has bought yes or no, the SUV, you have the answer in y_test.
cues.zh: 預測是否買 SUV，答案在 y_test。

cues.en: You're going to take the first result of y_test and thus you'll be able to compare your prediction to the real result to figure out whether your prediction was correct.
cues.zh: 取 y_test 第一個結果，便能比較預測和真值，知道是否正確。

cues.en: And so there you go. Please do the exercise.
cues.zh: 請完成練習。

cues.en: Please try to do this on your own first before we do it together in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 在下個教學一起做之前，先自行嘗試。

cues.en: Please predict the purchase decision of that first customer of the test set and we will of course implement the solution in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 預測測試集第一位顧客的購買決策，下節會實作解答。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
